timings.text: BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service
There is a separate qualification for BHW Eligibility under the Civil Service Commission (CSC Resolution No.

Four conditions are required: accredited by the local health board; completed a minimum of two (2) years of college leading to a degree; actively and voluntarily serving continuously, full time, for five (5) years or more as an accredited BHW; and having a satisfactory service record as an accredited BHW in the community.
The five years count only if the service was voluntary — no salary or other pay except an honorarium for the whole period — and only from the time the BHW was already accredited.
Service before 20 February 1995, when RA 7883 was approved, does not count.
A BHW hired under a job order or contract of service can still qualify.
This is not the same thing as general accreditation — it asks for more, and it is for BHWs who want official eligibility in the civil service.

BHWE needs four conditions — accreditation, two years of college, five years of continuous, full-time voluntary service as an accredited BHW, and a satisfactory record. Missing even one means it isn't met yet.
Ang BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service
May hiwalay na kwalipikasyon para sa BHW Eligibility sa ilalim ng Civil Service Commission (CSC Resolution No.

Apat na kondisyon ang kailangan: akreditado ng local health board; nakatapos ng minimum na dalawang (2) taon sa kolehiyo tungo sa isang degree; aktibo at boluntaryong naglilingkod nang tuloy-tuloy at full time sa loob ng limang (5) taon o higit pa bilang accredited BHW; at may satisfactory service bilang accredited BHW sa komunidad.
Bibilangin lang ang limang taon kung boluntaryo ang serbisyo — walang sahod o ibang bayad maliban sa honorarium sa buong panahon — at mula lamang nang akreditado na ang BHW.
Hindi binibilang ang serbisyo bago ang 20 Pebrero 1995, nang maaprubahan ang RA 7883.
Maaari pa ring mag-qualify ang BHW na naka-job order o contract of service.
Hindi ito parehong bagay sa pangkalahatang akreditasyon — mas mataas ang hinihingi nito, at para ito sa mga BHW na nais magkaroon ng opisyal na eligibility sa serbisyo sibil.

Apat na kondisyon ang kailangan sa BHWE — akreditasyon, dalawang taon sa kolehiyo, limang taon ng tuloy-tuloy, full-time at boluntaryong serbisyo bilang accredited BHW, at satisfactory service. Kulang ang isa, hindi pa ito matutugunan.
